LanguageData.RKU_FinalBattle.label: Final Battle
LanguageData.RKU_FinalBattle.letterText: The Partisans have assembled all local elite forces to launch a final battle against the colony. Every four hours, attacks of varying intensity will be launched based on the colony's status, with a total of six waves.
LanguageData.RKU_Incident_CaravanHijack.label: Partisan Supply Raid
LanguageData.RKU_Incident_CaravanHijack.letterText: The partisans have scouted a merchant caravan from the Ratkin Kingdom, led by nobles, within your base. They have resolved to seize this opportunity to launch a surprise attack and seize these valuable supplies. If you turn a blind eye to this, you will earn the gratitude of the partisans.
LanguageData.RKU_Incident_ConfusedRat.label: Confused White Ratkin
LanguageData.RKU_Incident_ConfusedRat.letterText: A confused white Ratkin appeared nearby, looking thoroughly perplexed.
LanguageData.RKU_IncidentWorker_FinalRaid.label: Final Raid
LanguageData.RKU_LimitedFleshbeastAttack.label: Earthquake: Fleshbeasts
LanguageData.RKU_LimitedFleshbeastAttack.letterText: The earth-shaking device triggered an earthquake that roused the Fleshbeasts, now surging forth from beneath the ground!
LanguageData.RKU_LimitedFleshbeastAttack.letterTextPl: The earth-shaking device triggered an earthquake that roused the Fleshbeasts, now surging forth from beneath the ground!
LanguageData.RKU_LimitedInsectAttack.label: Earthquake: Insectoids
LanguageData.RKU_LimitedInsectAttack.letterText: The earth-shaking device triggered an earthquake that roused the Insectoids, now surging forth from beneath the ground!
LanguageData.RKU_LimitedInsectAttack.letterTextPlural: The earth-shaking device triggered an earthquake that roused the Insectoids, now surging forth from beneath the ground!
LanguageData.RKU_RatkinTunnel_Fir.label: Ratkin Tunnel Partisans
LanguageData.RKU_RatkinTunnel_Fir.letterText: Underground activity detected. A Ratkin Tunnel Partisan unit is currently assaulting the colony.
